queries: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM per_account) AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, average_signed_amount, transaction_count, transaction_count / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM per_account) AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count FROM account_stats) SELECT s.account_id, s.average_signed_amount, s.transaction_count, s.transaction_count / o.average_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM account_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
